svg.title: Market Ecology Simulator — Interior view of the Adaptive Quarter
svg.desc: A room of desks seen in isometric projection. The momentum camp on the left is crowded, the value camp on the right has mostly empty desks, and agents are walking across the aisle after a strategy review. Side panels show the room roster and the decision trace of a single selected agent.
svg.text: CLICK A PIN FOR ITS TRACE
